output_list.criticism: The function allocateTokens is vulnerable to integer overflow. The totalSupply and balances variables are not properly checked for overflow. In the for loop, the totalSupply and balances variables are being updated with the sum of the value and the current balance. If the sum exceeds the maximum value for uint256, it will cause an integer overflow. This can be exploited by a malicious user to cause the contract to revert and prevent the tokens from being allocated.

The approveProxy function is vulnerable to integer overflow. The nonce variable is not properly checked for overflow. In the if statement, the nonce is being incremented by 1. If the nonce exceeds the maximum value for uint256, it will cause an integer overflow. This can be exploited by a malicious user to cause the contract to revert and prevent the nonce from being incremented.
